subject: Issue #37 checkout countdown
runner: Node.js vm with deterministic browser clocks and DOM stubs

cases.name: Delayed script subtracts 4 seconds between responseStart=1000 and performance.now=5000
Browser wall clock in year 2040 and another one-year change do not affect server countdown
Exact effective deadline disables demo payment and asks for refreshed DB status
Old template without serverNow anchors Date.now fallback at script start without subtracting preload twice
Browser without navigation timing falls back to script performance start
Unavailable responseStart=0 uses safe script anchor
Response timestamp after script start is rejected as invalid
Deadline passed during loading disables payment on initial render

limit: responseStart cannot measure server-to-client transit before first response bytes arrive; UI countdown is approximate and the server remains authoritative for expiry and payment.
